caption:
Your happiest customers are also the most forgetful.

They mean to leave a review. Then the next job starts and it slips their mind.

Most shops lose that window every time, one customer at a time.

The Black Arrow platform marks the job complete and sends the review request automatically. No sticky note. No "can you leave us a review" text you have to remember to send.

Run it on your own jobs for 14 days. No card needed.

rationale: Reel engagement is climbing and this closes the last untouched platform feature gap (review collection) with a pain every owner already feels.
